entities.summary: Levi Fontaine is an American former professional basketball shooting guard who played one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the San Francisco Warriors (1970–71). He attended the University of Maryland Eastern Shore where he was drafted by the Warriors during the fifth round of the 1970 NBA draft. Maryland averaged 102.8 points per game during Levi's senior year as it chalked up a 27–2 record, including a 23-game winning streak, and won the championship of the Central Intercollegiate Athletic Association.
